blocks.text: Fill ballot appears only once the room's motion is published; before that the adjudicator opens the room (R1) to publish it. Powers come from chairing a room — a guest chair (via /l/:code) has the same, checked by cab, sent to the engine as the club head. Feedback on the adjudicator stays hidden from them until the club head finishes the session.
